pages.title: Divine Staff
pages.text: The $(gold)Staff of Ra$() is the legendary weapon blessed by the sun god himself. It channels devastating solar energy against your enemies.

pages.title: Using the Staff
pages.text: $(l)Sun Beam Attack:$()$(br)Hold right-click to charge. The longer you charge, the more powerful the attack.$(br2)$(l)Effects:$()$(br)$(li)Sets enemies on fire$(li)Bonus damage to undead$(li)Creates light when held

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(tip)The Staff of Ra is particularly effective against $(curse)cursed creatures$() and undead enemies.$(br2)The ambient warmth protects against cold effects. Use it to light your way through dark tombs.
